name: Vegan World
source:
A retired activist experiences their first public event after total animal liberation has become law.

[From [url=https://thestoryteller.itch.io/vegan-world]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位已退居幕後的社會運動者，在全面解放動物的主張正式成為法律後，第一次參加了一場公共活動。
